Please use SECURITY.md for security vulnerabilities, not this public template.

### Environment

LAB commit/version, operating system, Lich/Ruby version, and selected provider
kind (no keys, account credentials, or private settings).

### Reproduction

Steps, expected result, actual result, and a short sanitized error excerpt.
Was this an isolated test or a player-authorized live session?

### Impact

Did it send a game command, lose state, block conversation, or only affect
display? Do not post raw game/chat logs or model transcripts.
